title: GLoC-EHR: Evidence-Cited Clinical Reasoning over Global Context and Local EHR Events
abstract: arXiv:2610.01076v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Structured electronic health records (EHRs) contain a patient's clinical trajectory as a sequence of clinical codes. Answering clinical questions from such records requires both the context of the whole trajectory and the specific events that support the answer. We introduce GLoC-EHR, a multimodal language model that reads a contextual encoding of the record through a fixed-size global memory of the trajectory and a local memory of selected events. The model learns to generate hospital-course summaries from the global memory and descriptions of masked concepts from the local memory, aligning both with clinical text. It is then trained to cite evidence before answering, through rationale fine-tuning followed by group relative policy optimization (GRPO) with rewards for correct answers and record-supported evidence. On three MIMIC-IV outcome tasks, GLoC-EHR attains the highest macro AUROC among the compared models when it answers directly,

translated_title: GLoC-EHR：基于全局上下文与局部电子健康记录事件的证据引用式临床推理
translated_abstract: 结构化电子健康记录（EHR）以临床代码序列的形式记录了患者的临床轨迹。要从这类记录中回答临床问题，既需要整个轨迹的全局上下文，也需要支持答案的特定事件。我们提出了GLoC-EHR，这是一种多模态语言模型，它通过轨迹的固定大小全局记忆和选定事件的局部记忆来读取记录的上下文编码。该模型学习从全局记忆生成住院过程摘要、从局部记忆生成被掩码概念的描述，并将两者与临床文本对齐。随后，模型被训练在回答之前先引用证据：先进行推理微调，再采用组相对策略优化（GRPO）进行强化学习，奖励机制针对正确答案和有记录支持的证据。在三个MIMIC-IV结局任务上，GLoC-EHR在直接回答时于所比较的模型中取得了最高的宏观AUROC。
tldr: GLoC-EHR是一种结合全局轨迹记忆与局部事件记忆的多模态语言模型，通过“先引用证据再回答”的训练方式（推理微调结合GRPO强化学习），在MIMIC-IV临床结局预测任务上取得了最高的宏观AUROC。
en_tdlr: GLoC-EHR is a multimodal language model combining global trajectory memory with local event memory, trained to cite evidence before answering via rationale fine-tuning and GRPO, achieving the highest macro AUROC on MIMIC-IV outcome prediction tasks.
